Unlocking Institutional Capital by Building Blockchain’s Compliance Layer
records.description_html: Major financial institutions like BlackRock, Fidelity, and UBS want access to onchain financial markets, but onchain compliance remains a significant barrier. Protocols today lack native identity, sanctions screening, and jurisdictional controls, keeping trillions in institutional liquidity sidelined and creating friction for both institutions and end users. In this fireside chat, Persona and Chainlink will explore how onchain attestations and identity infrastructure unlock compliant institutional participation in onchain financial markets. The conversation will cover how programmable, reusable identity works in practice, how it reduces fragmentation across platforms, and how it shifts compliance from siloed processes into a shared, verifiable standard. The discussion will also examine real-world adoption: who benefits first, what the most immediate use cases look like, and how the onchain financial system is set to evolve over the next few years. Attendees will gain a clearer understanding of how identity standards, onchain attestations, and oracle infrastructure work together to balance transparency, privacy, and security, enabling the next wave of institutional adoption.

records.description_html:
Join us for an exclusive deep dive into the infrastructure and economic models powering the next wave of Web3. From technical resilience to the massive potential of Real-World Assets (RWAs), we’re bringing together the industry’s most influential voices for two back-to-back panels.
Panel 1 | Trust Under Pressure: Can Tokenized Systems Stay Consistent at Scale?
Moderator: Pauline Shangett (NOWNodes) 
The Panelists are: Kwon Park (Crypto.com), Abi Dharshan (Zerion), Vidor Gencel (Solflare Wallet), and Phillip Z. (LI.FI).

How to manage system consistency when pushed to the limit.
The trade-offs between internal infra development and third-party providers.
Maintaining reliability in a fragmented, multi-chain ecosystem.
Panel 2 | Selling Trust: Can RWA Deliver on the Promise of Mass Adoption?
Moderator: Samuel Hood Burke (CCN) 
The Panelists are: Elias Enriquez (Houdini Swap), Martin Masser (TON Foundation), Gary Chan (Paxos), and Ryan Haczynski (GlobalStake).
The Discussion: RWAs are the bridge between traditional finance and Web3, but the path to mass adoption remains complex. This panel features leaders from regulated finance and high-growth ecosystems to evaluate:
What is truly driving RWA adoption today versus industry narrative.
Navigating liquidity constraints and the evolving regulatory landscape.
